thread:
Ori: quick sync — Legal pinged about tenant audit exports. they need exportable traces but with PII redaction guarantees. thinking: add per-tenant `exportable` flag + per-route sampling budget. if a request is sampled and tenant.exportable=true we keep full payload for 7d; otherwise we persist only scrubbed/hashed metadata. thoughts?

Jess: high level ok. main question: are we relying on heuristic scrubbing for non-exportable or mandatory tokenization/pseudonymization? heuristics drift is the legal risk. :thinking_face:

Sam: leaning towards conservative default: non-exportable -> full redaction (names, emails, SSN-looking tokens) at ingest. exportable tenants opt into full retention. budget idea: a monthly token/sample budget so exportable tenants can't blow up storage.

Maya: console UX note — product wants a clear indicator per-tenant: "Export allowed" and "Remaining export budget". also need audit trail for who toggled exportable. can we show percent-of-requests-covered by sampling?

Jess: for scrubbing, propose 2-layer approach: fast deterministic masks (regex + fast hmac for certain fields) then fallback to eval heuristics for low-confidence cases but drop confidence > 0.8 only to internal review queue, not stored. code sketch for route config: 
```json
{
  "route": "/v1/generate",
  "sampling": {
    "mode": "sticky_hash",
    "rate": 0.02,
    "budget_per_tenant_month": 10000
  },
  "export_policy": {
    "exportable_flag": "tenant.exportable",
    "retention_days": 7
  }
}
```

Sam: sticky_hash helps measurement consistency. on quota: we need atomic increment + forecast UI. if budget exhausted, sampled requests should still serve but we mark as stored=scrubbed and decrement a soft counter for metrics.

Ori: permission model — toggle should be an org-admin/Legal-only action. also need a canary rollout (start with 10 orgs). proposal: feature-flag `exportable-rollout:v1` with canary list.

Maya: UX for canary: show in tenant settings "Can request export (canary)" with tooltip linking to audit playbook. show expected storage delta when enabling.

Jess: implementation note — redaction must run before any logging sinks (datadog, s3). ensure the ingest path has mandatory scrub step. also add a debug endpoint that returns scrubbed vs original fingerprints for QA (no raw payloads).

Sam: ops / billing — we should emit a meter per exported token and charge to tenant bucket. will need a rate-limiting circuit to avoid spikes.

Ori: question for infra — how expensive is keeping full payloads for 7d for 10k budget? @oncall-bot can we get rough numbers?

oncall-bot: estimate run: 10k samples * 2KB avg payload * 10 orgs => ~200MB/day, ~1.4GB/week. replication/storage overhead ~x3 => ~4.2GB/week. (very rough)

Maya: that's ok for MVP. next: ownership + roadmap items?

Ori: action items: 1) Eng-platform: PR for sticky sampler + atomic tenant quota (sam) 2) Eng-infra: storage/cost estimate + retention enforcement (oncall-bot to coordinate) 3) Devex: console mockups for export flag + budget (Maya) 4) Legal/Product: define exportable policy and audit checklist (Jess)

Jess: +1. I'll draft policy doc and a short checklist for QA. will ping legal.

Sam: starting sampler branch today, will post RFC link when ready.

Ori: ok closing — canary list: add orgs alpha-ops, test-co, partner-x for initial rollout. re-check in 1 week. :thumbsup:

Maya: acked.

Jess: ack.

Sam: ack.
